summary: Provisional buffer credits not allocated after quantized-model fallback to hosted during mixed-queue batch
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports provisional buffer credits (hourly buffer) were not applied to their org after an automated fallback from a quantized dedicated variant to a hosted non-quantized variant during a large mixed-queue batch run.

Impact:
- LexiChat saw ~18 hours of reserved/provisional buffer disappear from the console and a provisional invoice shortfall for the billing window.
- Customer-facing pipelines reported elevated token counts in hosted aggregation and a higher-than-expected final invoice.

Environment:
- Dedicated pool: lexichat-dedicated-prod (us-west).
- Fallback target: hosted-us-west-primary.
- Time window: 2026-03-09 22:10 - 2026-03-10 02:30 UTC.

Steps to reproduce (customer provided):
1) Submit mixed-queue batch job (embeddings + chat-inference) with pin to quantized variant on dedicated.
2) Dedicated pool hit a transient GPU OOM; auto-fallback routed requests to hosted non-quantized variant.
3) Job completes; console shows hosted-metering for that window but provisional buffer credit line not consumed/allocated to customer ledger.

Observed behavior:
- Hosted postbacks recorded usage at hosted rates.
- Hourly provisional buffer count in account decreased in UI but was not translated to a billing credit in provisional invoice export.
- Console estimate stayed lower, causing customer confusion; finalized invoice reflected hosted consumption without buffer offset.

Expected behavior:
- When fallback occurs for capacity reasons, provisional buffer credits reserved for the customer's dedicated usage should be consumed/allocated to offset hosted fallback costs for that window (per SLA/credits policy).

Attachments:
- Customer-provided job IDs and timestamps.
- Console screenshot showing buffer counter drop and missing invoice line.
- Example of postback payload header (obfuscated keys).
comments: 2026-03-10 09:14 - Aisha Khan (Support): Received initial report from LexiChat. Acknowledged and requested job IDs, postback samples, and provisional invoice export.
2026-03-10 11:02 - LexiChat (Customer): Provided job IDs and redacted postback lines. Notes that fallback events show in the console 'fallback: hosted' tag at 22:23 UTC.

2026-03-10 13:45 - Priya Desai (Billing Eng): Investigating; reproduced some postbacks in staging. Suspect that quantized-rate-tokenization caused a metering-class mismatch during fallback and the credits reconciler skipped allocation for mixed-queue batches.

2026-03-11 08:30 - SRE (Miguel Torres): Found transient OOM on dedicated pool at 22:21 UTC; fallback routing triggered 3k requests to hosted. Posting trace links to internal dashboard: #support thread.

2026-03-11 14:20 - Priya Desai (Billing Eng): Confirmed reconciler skip pattern for requests tagged with 'quantized_variant' + 'fallback_hosted' when mixed toolcall/embeddings payloads present. Creating patch PR to include fallback mapping in reconciler.
2026-03-12 10:05 - LexiChat (Customer): Appreciated quick updates; requested provisional credit line to be applied before invoice finalization. Asked for ETA and manual waiver if fix misses cycle.

2026-03-12 18:50 - Priya Desai (Billing Eng): Communicated temporary workaround (manual ledger credit) executed and linked PR #1834 for reconciler fix. Will monitor next run and confirm permanent fix roll out.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: credit reconciler keyed on model variant id and queue type. During fallback, hosted postbacks used hosted-rate model_id but retained legacy 'quantized_meta' tag from client payload, creating a tag-combination not covered by reconciler rules.
Logs: reconciler logs show pattern 'skip_credit: unknown_combination' for ~2,843 postback lines within window. Stacktrace points to function map_credit_for_postback in reconciler service.
Reproducer: created synthetic postback with mixture of 'tool_calls' and 'embeddings' that mirrors customer's payload; reconciler skipped allocation in staging.

Patch approach: expand reconciler mapping to treat 'fallback_hosted' as equivalent to original dedicated model_id when provisional buffer exists within same hourly bucket. Add unit test for mixed-queue payloads.
Rollout plan: land PR to canary 03/13, monitor canary reconciler logs for skip reductions, then roll to prod with a midnight window to avoid mid-cycle churn.
resolution: Temporary: Applied manual ledger credit to LexiChat for the missing provisional buffer amount for the affected hours (credit reference CLR-2026-391827). Permanent: Merged reconciler patch (PR #1834) to include fallback_hosted mapping logic for quantized->hosted transitions and mixed-queue payload handling. Canary monitored for 12 hours; postback skip rate dropped to 0. Deployed to prod 2026-03-13 02:00 UTC. Follow-up: scheduled a postmortem and a small billing policy doc update clarifying fallback credit behavior.
